english.title: Rape a man 16 or over - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally penetrated the

(A)_[anus]_
(B)_[mouth]_
(C)_[anus and mouth]_

of a man with your penis, when he did not consent and you did not reasonably believe that he was consenting
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally without consent penetrated the anus / mouth of a male person aged 16 years or over
with penis not reasonably believing that he had consented

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the wording of the attempted offence see offence wording H5658
(ii) Officers should carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(iii) Where the victim is under 13 years of age, although it is feasible to charge under section 1, CPS advise that in every case the appropriate charge should be laid under section 5 of the Sexual Offence Act 2003. See also offence wording H5669.
(iv) A prior conviction for an offence listed in Schedule 15 to the Sentencing Act 2020, may render the convicted person liable to a mandatory life sentence in relation to a second offence listed under that Schedule, as per Section 273 (offender aged 18 or over but under 21 when convicted of the second offence or Section 283 (offender aged 21 or over).

other.penalty:
Indictable only - Life imprisonment

See Note (ii) above re mandatory life sentence

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
